identification: Two modern/vintage walking sticks with cast brass animal-head handles (one a duck head, the other a dog/bird head per catalogue) on varnished hardwood shafts with brass collars, one shaft with dark bands and rubber ferrule. Typical reproduction/souvenir 'Victorian style' canes of the type sold in bulk from India; not antique, no maker marks.

viewing_check: Estimate $30-50 for the pair, no current bid shown. Check handles are solid brass not plated, shafts straight with no splits, collars secure, rubber ferrules present. One handle is described as a dog; photo shows both heads similar bird-like, check. Comparable single duck-head sticks sell A$40 to A$65 on eBay AU (2023 to 2026, flat), mostly new imports. A pair at $30-50 is near the single-stick price.
